versions.localizedDescription: TEST 0.3.8 — Experimental prerelease. Not verified on a phone. No confirmed fix for the memory crash. Experimental prerelease. Not verified on a phone. This build does not claim to fix the memory crash: that is still unproven.

TEST 0.3.7c — Experimental prerelease. Not verified on a phone. No confirmed fix for the memory crash. Experimental prerelease. Not verified on a phone. Menu, bot names and options changes. It does not fix the memory crash: that is still unproven and the 0.3.7b log showed about the same footprint (~3067 MiB).

Tested on one phone (iPhone 13 Pro Max, about 3 GB for the app): the lobby and in-match bot rows work and mp_rust loads, but a match still ends when iOS closes the app for memory after a few minutes. This release does not fix that. It adds bots you can add in the lobby and during a match, an opti...

Test build aimed at phones with a 3 GB memory grant (iPhone 13 Pro Max, iPhone 15, SideStore with a free account), where mp_rust was closed by iOS while the map prepared its graphics. Not yet tested on a phone. Please send iw4l-boot.log and iw4l-memory-settings.txt.

Built to get mp_rust running on the iPhone 13 Pro Max (A15) and to make problem reports easy. Tested on an iPhone 13 Pro Max: the graphics error is gone and the IW4 Pocket options work, but the app still runs out of memory while the map prepares its graphics (see Known).
Built to find out where the memory goes and why the app quits after loading mp_rust. It is not a fix, and it has not been run on a phone yet (the package was checked, the game was not).
The app now looks at the phone and picks its own memory settings. This is the biggest change since 0.2.0.
This candidate changes memory ownership and shader scheduling, not just diagnostics.
